_about: Configuration for scripts/sync-agent-stubs.py (DOC-G3).
Copy this file to docs/governance/stub-policy.json and edit it. The copy is
project-owned: the harness never manages it, so your edits are not drift.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the gate.
canonical_root          where the real rule text lives. Exactly one home.
agents_file             the cross-tool instruction file (AGENTS.md) that most
agent tools read. The gate owns a delimited block
inside it and never the file, because the rest of it
is yours. The block holds pointers only — restating
doctrine there would be a second head of truth.
Run with --write to create or refresh it; without
--write a missing or stale block is a finding.
Remove the key to opt out entirely.
rules                   Markdown basenames that need an ecosystem pointer.
stub_roots              tool-specific directories that receive generated
pointer files. Run with --write to regenerate them;
without --write the gate reports staleness.
forbidden_content_roots directories that must never hold rule content of
their own. A second content-bearing rule home is a
fork of truth, which is what this gate exists to
prevent.
Leave stub_roots empty until a second agent tool actually reads rules from
its own directory; an empty list keeps the gate green and generates nothing.
